>
> - **一時 disable**: frontmatter に `disable-model-invocation: true` を設定している（Claude Code 公式 Skill 仕様では、Claude の自動 invoke と SubAgent への preload が抑止される）。したがって `pr-reviewer.md` の `skills: [pr-review-judge]` による preload は **まだ有効ではない**。これは意図的な deferred であり、本番稼働の証明ではない。動作検証と下記の未移管依存が揃うまで解除しない。
> - **no-dispatch / no-publish**: 手動 `/pr-review-judge` は disable では防げない。手動 invoke された場合でも、本移管（D5）では実レビュー手順（PR 本文 evaluator・CI provenance script・gate script の実行）と verdict 投稿（`gh pr comment` 等の GitHub 書込）、Reviewer SubAgent の dispatch を **実行しない**（fail-closed）。本文は read-only の documentation として読むに留める。
> - **未移管の hard dependency**（実レビュー手順が参照するが本 repository には存在しない）: `open-pr` Skill と `validate_pr_body.py`、`pr-review-judge/scripts/ci_verdict_summary.py` / `ci_verdict_summary_v2.py` / `check_pr_review_gates.py` / `wait_pr_checks.py`、`implement-issue` Skill、`gemini-cli-headless-delegation` Skill、`.claude/hooks/pr_reviewer_guard.py`、`docs/dev/workflow.md`、`docs/dev/schema-governance.md`、`.github/pull_request_template.md`。後続の runtime 結線工程の担当である（owner / rerun_condition は manifest の `unmigrated_references`）。移管済みなのは `scripts/allowed_paths_review_gate.py` と `impl-review-loop/scripts/wait_ci_checks.py` のみ。
> - 現行の正本は `AGENTS.md` / `docs/dev/github-ops.md`。本文中の旧 repository の Issue・PR 番号、`docs/dev/workflow.md`、ゲーム固有の例は移管元の履歴記述であり、現行の実行認可や正本ではない。

decisions.slice: I-4-4D5: migrate pr-review-judge/SKILL.md, pr-reviewer-lite.md and the 10 references the Skill's Reference Loading Map points to, and restore the D4 deferred 3-consumer test unchanged. No wrapper, shared schema or permanent gate is added; the existing runner is reused.
decisions.auto_invocation: pr-review-judge/SKILL.md carries a temporary `disable-model-invocation: true` (Claude Code official Skill spec: no automatic invocation and no preload into a SubAgent). Consequently the `skills: [pr-review-judge]` declaration of pr-reviewer.md (unchanged) does not preload the Skill yet; this is an intentional deferred state, not proof of production operation. A manual /pr-review-judge is still possible, so the body states the fail-closed rule: no review procedure, no verdict publish, no dispatch in D5. The disable is released only by the slice that completes and verifies the wiring.
decisions.no_dispatch: Nothing here starts an Agent or SubAgent (pr-reviewer-lite included), runs a review, calls live GitHub write operations, mutates a Git ref or publishes a verdict.
decisions.lite_agent_boundary: tools (Bash, Read, Grep, Glob), disallowedTools (Agent, Edit, Write, MultiEdit, Skill) and permissionMode dontAsk are unchanged from the source. Only the deny-list was adapted: scripts, tests, config, .github, hooks, settings, pyproject.toml, uv.lock, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md and manifest changes now fail closed to the Sonnet pr-reviewer instead of being treated as a docs-only lightweight review.
decisions.legacy_content: Body text of the Skill and references is kept as source history: legacy Issue / PR numbers, the legacy workflow document, game-specific examples and one legacy repository comment URL are inert here and the migration-status note says so. The 10 references are byte-identical to the source.
decisions.restoration: The unchanged source test test_canonical_evaluator_consumers_use_same_function now passes under real pytest because the 3 consumers (pr-review-judge/SKILL.md, pr-reviewer-lite.md, steps/step-4-pr-review.md) exist and mention wait_ci_checks. The source test file was not edited.
decisions.production_claim: Migrating these files does not make PR review, verdict publishing, the Final Gate or LOOP_HANDOFF_RESULT_V1 wiring runnable; real-pytest PASS and document parity are not evidence of Skill preload or Agent dispatch.
